verdict.rationale: A probe notes that a www.uscis.gov Crawl-delay of 10 was honored, which implies the main site serves a readable robots.txt. However, the public case-status host (egov.uscis.gov) returns HTTP 403 behind a Cloudflare challenge for robots.txt itself, so agents cannot learn what they may read there before fetching. Missing for 10: a direct capture of the www.uscis.gov robots.txt contents, a readable robots.txt on egov.uscis.gov, and first-party documentation of crawler policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
